scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @investorkit/api" "npm run dev -w @investorkit/web"
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @investorkit/shared && npm run build -w @investorkit/db && npm run build -w @investorkit/portfolio-engine && npm run build -w @investorkit/report-engine
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @investorkit/api && npm run build -w @investorkit/web
